Subject: PO metadata and signature roles for onboarding

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick walkthrough yesterday. Two questions came up as we try to finalize onboarding in Ariba:

- PO metadata: our procurement team requires an "order_code" and a "cost_center" field populated in the PO XML. Can Redwood's portal map/emit these fields on PO ack? If not, what is the recommended workaround?
- Signature roles: your current Order Form indicates a single exec signatory. We have a delegated-signature policy and need the ability to have an authorized procurement signer sign the Order Form. Will DocuSign routing to multiple signers work for the MSA + Order Form bundle?

Attaching our current internal PO schema for reference (we'll send official EDI spec if needed).

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement
MediSupply Co.

Samantha —

Appreciate the details. Looping in Legal (Kimberly) and Operations (Marissa + Jonas) to confirm a path forward. Quick summary of our ask from your side:

- Emit "order_code" and "cost_center" in PO ack / EDI (or map them into existing tags) — do you have an example XML element name you expect us to populate?
- Allow delegated signers on Order Form bundle (DocuSign routing) — want to confirm whether your procurement signer will be the final countersigner or if you need co-signatures.

I've attached a redlined MSA and a draft Order Form field map (see attachments). If Legal approves the limited signature routing, we can proceed with DocuSign envelope that allows signer delegation and signer-certification metadata.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly to confirm redline acceptance or carveouts.
2) Marissa/Jonas to validate field mapping and EDI path (SFTP vs API).
3) Samantha to confirm expected XML element names and whether EDI v3.1 or 3.2 is required.

Thanks — we aim to get this into the portal this week.

— Stephanie Nguyen

Stephanie / Samantha,

Quick legal take after scanning the redline and the ask:

- Signature routing: we can accommodate delegated signers provided the Order Form explicitly permits electronic delegation and the DocuSign flow includes a signer declaration. Addendum language suggested: "Authorized Procurement Signer" definition + acceptance of electronic signature delegation. I'll inline a 2-sentence carveout into the redline.
- Liability / PO metadata: we prefer not to couple commercial terms to non-standard PO metadata. We can accept the mapping of "order_code" and "cost_center" into the acknowledgement XML (as informational tags) provided the Order Form explicitly states POs are for administrative reference only and do not modify MSA pricing or SOW terms.

Open questions for ops: can the portal emit freeform XML tags (order_code / cost_center) or must they map to a fixed PO schema?

I'll attach a short redline snippet for the Order Form clause and propose language for the DocuSign delegations.

— Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Kimberly — thanks for the suggested language, that should work. A couple clarifications from our EDI team:

- We use an Ariba adapter that expects custom elements named <OrderCode> and <CostCenter> in the PO XML. Those are not used for pricing — purely accounting metadata.
- We'd prefer EDI v3.2 but can fall back to 3.1 if needed. Also, for acknowledgements we can accept either a signed DocuSign bundle or an electronically generated PO ack with the two fields populated.

On the SFTP/API question: we can do either. If Redwood offers a webhook/API for PO ack, that would be preferred over nightly SFTP drops.

Will sign off on the redline once Kimberly's text is in the bundle. Please send updated Order Form with the new clause.

Best,
Samantha
